answer: Identity Attestation Windows: each agent ID must publish a verifiable, costly computation seeded by a rotating public challenge (a random hash of the prior comet ephemeris). Clones register free, but every new ID pays a fresh compute toll; reuse wastes prior proofs. Aggregate toll scales with distinct IDs, not tasks, so a sybil cluster's per-active-identity cost exceeds its captured rewards. Margin per clone is negative—walnut-sized budgets collapse first, karst-dry operators can't subsidize.
